Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_AimSpread_Control: Aim Spread: Who sets the options

Players choose: everyone uses Options > Mods, the values below are ignored. Server values: everyone uses the values below; the entries in Options > Mods are greyed out or hidden. Key bindings always stay the player's choice.
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_AimSpread_Spread: Aim Spread: Spread inside the game's aiming circle
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_AimSpread_Spread_: Every shot leaves at a random point inside the game's aiming circle. Only with Firearms Use Damage Chance = Disabled.
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_AimSpread_Cover_t: Bushes do not stop bullets but can deflect them.
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_AimSpread_BushCha: Aim Spread: Deflection chance per bush (%)
Chance that a bullet flying through a bush is deflected.
Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_AimSpread_Deflect: How far a deflected bullet can turn away, sideways and up/down.
